_comment: Generated art for Crow Funding. tools/generate_art.ps1 reads this (it forwards
to the shared generator in Games/_pipeline/tools).
First test (2026-09-26): one crow in the ref-1 pen-and-ink style, two style
LoRAs x two strengths, 4 seeds each, written to art/_preview/ with -Preview.
The crow will later be split into body/wing/scarf parts and animated in code,
so it must be side-on with the wing clearly readable, and the scarf left white
so crow.gd can tint it with scarf_color (the one spot colour).

defaults.prompt: a single cartoon crow standing on its two feet, full body in side view facing right, folded wing clearly outlined on its side, wearing a small plain white scarf knotted around its neck, round white eye with a black pupil, cheeky friendly expression
defaults.negative: colour, color, grey wash, gradient, shading tones, painterly, photorealistic, photograph, 3d render, multiple birds, duplicate, second crow, background, scenery, ground, branch, rooftop, paper texture, lined paper, drop shadow, cast shadow, text, watermark, signature, frame, border, cropped, cut off, blurry
